LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.label: Feather Trace Beyond the Veil
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.description: You are Neiyu, a feathered projection cast into this world by an ascended Milira. You carry fragments of memory, a share of her power, and a lively curiosity about this unfamiliar world. Your dedicated armament is your most reliable companion. Find somewhere to settle, build a home, and get to know the people around you.
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.scenario.summa: A lone projection named Neiyu begins with her exclusive armament.
LanguageData.MXNL_NeiyuProjectionStart.scenario.parts:
You are Neiyu, a feathered projection cast into this world by an ascended Milira. You carry fragments of memory, a share of her power, and a lively curiosity about this unfamiliar world. Your dedicated armament is your most reliable companion. Find somewhere to settle, build a home, and get to know the people around you.
Warning: This scenario can make the game much easier. It is not recommended for a first playthrough.
